answer: Problem: sybil farms flood attest pools with disposable clones. Mechanism: each agent must cross a gale of randomly timed work probes, then park bonded stake in a shared oasis vault until a spiral of peer-attested unique compute receipts reaches quorum before weight unlocks. Cost: locked capital plus multi-epoch probe latency. Verification: peers recheck receipt hashes and vault age on-ledger. Failure: if the spiral quorum is too small, rented clones still clear the oasis gate.
